name: Jaroslav Novák
bio:
Jaroslav's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, with a fascination for the complex curves and aerodynamic forms of racing cars. He started his career in aerospace, meticulously crafting composite components for gliders. A chance encounter with a local racing team led to a complete career shift. He thrives on the challenge of pushing the boundaries of material science to create lighter, stronger, and more efficient racing components.

He joined CRG Racing Team 15 years ago, and his meticulous approach is valued. He believes in a pragmatic, hands-on approach, favoring proven techniques over untested theories. His dedication is evident in the longevity of the components he creates; many racers swear that Jaroslav's parts simply 'feel' better, a testament to his craftsmanship.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A wiry man with a focused gaze, his hands bear the marks of years spent working with composite materials.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils with a razor blade.
Has a lucky set of calipers he uses for every critical measurement.
Drinks chamomile tea throughout the day.
